results.title: Kamara Launches 'Here for C.H.R.I.S' Mental‑Health Campaign After Hospitalised with Apraxia
results.description: Former football pundit Chris Kamara reveals his struggle with depression after apraxia diagnosis, and announces a new partnership with Visit Guernsey to create safe spaces for men to discuss mental health. The initiative stems from personal losses, including friends Gary Speed and Ricky Hatton, and aims to encourage open dialogue across the UK.
